clips.title: The story
paras: Following the trail of Captain Hecklebury Smotts' lost weapon, Sprogger reveals a plan to bait the giant Negolash using the creature's favorite delicacies. By staging a banquet in a wrecked lifeboat on the coast of Stranglethorn Vale, adventurers can confront the brute and reclaim the captain's stolen cutlass.

When giants smashed Captain Smotts' vessel, one brute named Negolash headed straight for the galley. Unlike his brethren, he wasn't hungry for the crew. Sprogger saw that Negolash wanted wine and Barbecued Buzzard Wings, Sprogger's own specialty, whose recipe he had to travel to the Badlands to get.

To lure the giant, Sprogger devises an irresistible feast. Adventurers must haul ten helpings of the wings alongside five bottles of wine into the captain's ruined lifeboat down the southeastern shoreline. Drawn by the smell of the banquet, Negolash can be cornered, slain, and stripped of the captain's prize blade.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When the giants destroyed our ship, Negolash went straight for my kitchen. He wasn't hungry for crew like the other giants. Negolash wanted wine...and my Barbecued Buzzard Wings. They're my specialty, and I had to go all the way to the Badlands for the recipe!

If you want to lure the giant, then get some wine and a heap of buzzard wings. Put them in our old lifeboat, southeast of here along the coast. When Negolash smells all that food, he'll come for sure!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you get my cutlass, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got my cutlass from Negolash! I can't believe my fortune, friend! Meeting you has turned my luck to the better, make no mistake there!
Thank you! And if I ever get a new ship and you're looking to sail the seas, you would be my honored guest.
